fields.FIR_Description: As per the complaint recorded on 2026-01-08, a maroon scooter bearing registration number TN-68-ZZ-1065 of the complainant was reported missing from Vetri Layout Industrial Area in Coimbatore. The time of the incident was given as 22:05 on 2026-01-08. The complainant could not identify the person involved. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. Potentially relevant material referenced includes photographs, physical documents and CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Vehicle allegedly taken after the handle lock was forced.
fields.Keywords: scooter theft, vehicle, industrial area, scooter, documents, photograph, night
